status: Integration specification; not deployed spell definitions or server handlers

excludedDestinations.name: Acherus: The Ebon Hold
excludedDestinations.reason: User excluded due to Death Knight restrictions

modes.Hybrid: Mage original or selected second class

factionRule: Use actual character faction: Alliance only Alliance, Horde only Horde, Neutral either. Apply to both learning and travel, including each portal passenger.
ownershipRule: Independent character Mastery entitlement. Never grant Rune account ownership or spend unlock runes. Allocate distinct Mage spell and portal IDs after collision checks.
passengerRule: Caster or member of the same party/subgroup; check each passenger faction, destination access and level. Passenger need not own the Mastery or Rune.
arrivalRule: Alive, out of combat, not in flight or battleground; preserve destination quests, reputation at least Neutral, enabled flag and phase. Do not compare unrelated origin phase.

reagentRule.trigger: Successful travel by caster only; once per cast, including caster traversal of own portal. No reward on failed/cancelled cast, portal creation alone, or another passenger traversal.
reagentRule.delivery: Server confirms arrival and persists a unique reward operation. If inventory is full, defer delivery without duplicating or losing the reward. Rune collection unlock items are unaffected.

levelBasis: Design using zone progression; city levels explicitly set by user. Other starter settlements have a 15 minimum. These levels are not imported Rune requirements.
